entries.title: Classical–quantum light interactions could make complex quantum behavior easier to simulate
entries.summary: An international collaboration demonstrates that classical nonlinear dynamics can drive single- and two-photon states to thermalize, opening new avenues for simulating complex quantum many-body systems within accessible optical architectures.
